name: Image Editor
author: FryPDF Team
description: Professional layered design and photo editing studio: inpainting Remove tool, Curves, Liquify, Shadows/Highlights, Black & White adjustments, text warp, Adobe Grd/Abr/Patterns and FITS/PCX/KRA codecs, OpenType typography, layers panel, and template gallery.
releaseNotes: Adds inpainting Remove tool, Shadows/Highlights and Black & White adjustments, Curves and Liquify engines, text warp Bezier distortion, expanded codecs (Adobe Grd/Abr/Patterns, FITS, PCX, KRA), OpenType typography features, color range selection, and enhanced studio workflows.
